_about: The Opening plan's one settings file (companion/opening_plan). Every list, time and number of the playbook is here, so a later playbook is a new file, not new code. Display only: nothing here places an order. See companion/opening_plan/__init__.py for where each number comes from.
name: OV OR1 shares

size._stage_about: Step 9 size stage (companion/plan_size.py, brief 19): what a plan entry sends. "1_share" (the default, the test stage) sends 1 share; 0.10, 0.25, 0.50 or 1.0 send floor(plan shares x stage), at least 1, inside the ticket's limits. Nothing else is allowed. Raising it is its own one-line PR that quotes Ash's go for that stage (who, when, where). A stage above 1 share needs EDGE_TRADER_PLAN_FLAT=1 (the cover watch) and every point of README section "Before any stage above 1 share", including the rule for a stop under entry.min_stop_atr, which Ash decides.

estimate._about: Brief 22: estimated shares on the plan rows before the 09:30 minute exists, display only (companion/opening_plan/plan.py estimate_row). Shares = risk used / (ATR x a typical first-minute range), at the row's last price. From the 2026 study /mnt/project-files/ov-research/allocation/pm_bar_break_trades.parquet, column or1_risk_atr: OV's top 4, 835 picks on 209 days (2026-01-02 to 2026-10-30), median 0.268, quartiles 0.193 and 0.373. Never a size: no button or send reads it.

show.note: Ash's pick, 2026-11-13 17:38:49 UTC, on the card "Choose how the plan estimates shares before the first minute exists" in the thread "Review OV picks desk architecture": "About N, usually L to H" (each row at a typical first minute of 0.27 x ATR with the usual range 0.19 to 0.37 x ATR, plus the most that buying power allows). Allowed: range (about N, usually N1 to N2), cautious (one number at wide_atr) or none (no estimate)

cover._about: Step 9 partial-fill cover watch (companion/plan_flat.py, brief 19 Part C), only with EDGE_TRADER_PLAN_FLAT=1. A plan row whose shares have no working stop for longer than this turns red with an Add stop button (the user's click). Display only: nothing is sent by the clock.

buttons._about: Step 4 row buttons (companion/plan_entries.py), only with EDGE_TRADER_PLAN_BUTTONS=1 and EDGE_TRADER_BREAK_ENTRY=1. Start value from the fast-open design (max 3 flips), not yet approved by Ash.

tape._about: Brief 15: Edge Scanner's open tape (scanner/open_tape.py), read by companion/opening_plan/tape.py for the shadow and the armed plan. One LAN GET to Edge Scanner, inside Step 2's approved link; Edge Scanner answers from memory and asks Alpaca for nothing more. On 2026-11-13 the recorder read a snapshot every 0.50 s (840 in 7 minutes, request p50 48 ms, p95 143 ms, max 488 ms), the snapshot's minute bar became the 09:30 bar at 09:31:00.08-0.65 ET, and SPY's newest trade was 60-150 ms old at arrival (busy names), COIN and CRWD 0.4-1 s (p95 4.5 s).

every_seconds.note: start number, not approved by Ash
every_seconds.why: half the recorder's 0.5 s poll (2026-11-13: 2.00 snapshots a second), so a new snapshot is seen within about 0.25 s

timeout_seconds.note: start number, not approved by Ash
timeout_seconds.why: a memory read on the LAN; a late answer is a problem, never waited for

stale_seconds.note: start number, not approved by Ash
stale_seconds.why: Edge Scanner's newest snapshot to now: 0.5 s poll + 0.25 s read + the request (2026-11-13 p95 143 ms, 220 ms in 09:30:00-30)

feed_late_seconds.note: start number, not approved by Ash
feed_late_seconds.why: SPY's newest trade or quote to the answer in hand; 2026-11-13 SPY trades were 60-150 ms old at arrival plus up to about 0.75 s of polling

calls_per_minute.note: start number, not approved by Ash; counts and refuses sends only (architect, 2026-11-13 15:47 UTC). The limit that binds is the poller's own MAX_PER_MIN 70 (companion/poller.py _throttle), not Schwab's 120: Edge Trader's order calls count there and never wait, so the poller's reads wait (live test 2026-11-13: 76 and 78 calls in a minute, poller reads up to 14.8 s late). Brief 24 changes the poller (architect's live-test notes N1)

calls_per_send.note: the code's worst case (architect, 2026-11-13 16:02 UTC): 4 usual (the quote in break_entry.prepare, the POST, two status reads after a 201, fork PR #15), 5 when an earlier close or partial on the name still has an open status (Trader._blocked -> _unresolved_close reads that order once); tests/test_plan_auto.py pins both

calls_per_cancel.note: the code's worst case: Trader.cancel_entry reads the order, cancels, and reads back up to ten times; never refused by the calls bound, logged with each cancel; tests/test_plan_auto.py pins it

every_seconds.note: start number, not approved by Ash; how often the armed plan reads the open tape (brief 15 tape.every_seconds)

end_grace_seconds.note: start number, not approved by Ash; a backstop: the watch-end cancels run from watch_until_et until this much later, then the arm ends. Sized from the worst case (architect's review, 2026-11-13 16:21 UTC): one confirmed cancel is up to about 6.7 s (a read, the cancel and ten read-backs 0.25 s apart at 0.35 s a call), so four take up to about 27 s

clock_ahead_seconds.note: start number, not approved by Ash; data stamped more than this after our clock makes the reading unusable (the clock looks behind)
